mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demo_orders (customer_name, status, pay_method, user_grade, created_at) VALUES ( #{customerName}, #{status}, #{payMethod}, #{userGrade}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
INSERT INTO demo_order_items (order_id, product_name, sku, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productName}, #{sku}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, product_name AS productName, sku, quantity FROM demo_order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, customer_name, status, pay_method, user_grade, created_at FROM demo_orders ORDER BY id
